days.name: Opener
days.focus: 8 minutes. Breathing, neck and hip activation.

items.name: Lying 90/90 breathing (calves on a chair)
items.cue: Breathe low into ribs and belly. Long, relaxed breath out. No squeezing.

items.name: Standing chin tucks
items.cue: Stand tall with your back and head against a wall. Glide the chin straight back, like making a double chin. Hold 2 seconds, release.

items.name: Glute bridge
items.cue: Press through heels and lift until hips are level. Ribs stay down.

items.name: Standing march
items.cue: Tall posture, slow knee lift, no leaning back. Keep marching for the full 30 seconds.

days.name: Monday
days.focus: Legs, hips and calves. Squat focus.
days.note: Month progression: start at the low end of sets and reps, add reps first, then add a set. Move up only when every rep feels controlled.

items.name: Hip 90/90
items.cue: Sit on a cushion with both knees bent at 90 degrees, one in front and one to the side. Gently rotate the knees from side to side, tall spine, no forcing.

items.name: Quadruped knee circles
items.cue: On hands and knees, lift one knee slightly and draw slow circles. Keep the trunk still and the movement pain-free.

items.name: Squat
items.cue: Start with 1 set and add sets as it feels easy. Sit back to a chair as a depth guide, then stand up as you breathe out.

items.name: Hip hinge
items.cue: Push hips back, flat back, long neck. Go only as deep as stays pain-free. Same exercise on Monday and Thursday. Over the month, build from 1 set of 6 reps to 3 sets of 10.

items.name: Side-lying hip abduction
items.cue: Lie on your side, hips stacked, top leg slightly behind you. Lift the leg without rolling backward.

items.name: Calf raises
items.cue: Hold a wall or counter. Rise slowly onto the toes, pause, lower for 3 seconds.

items.name: Toe raises
items.cue: Back against a wall, heels on the floor. Lift the toes toward the shins, lower slowly.

items.name: Side plank (on knees)
items.cue: Line from knees to head. Breathe out, do not hold your breath.

days.name: Tuesday
days.focus: Chest, back, shoulders and arms. Press focus.
days.note: Month progression: start at the low end of sets and reps, add reps first, then add a set. Move up only when every rep feels controlled.

items.name: Shoulder dislocates (band or broomstick)
items.cue: Wide grip, arms straight. Lift the band overhead and as far behind as is comfortable, then return. Widen the grip if it pinches.

items.name: Shoulder internal and external rotation (elbow at side)
items.cue: Elbow bent 90 degrees and tucked to your side. Rotate the forearm inward, then outward, with a light band or no weight.

items.name: Lying dumbbell chest press
items.cue: Lie on a bed or bench with knees bent, feet flat. Press the 5 kg dumbbells up, lower slowly. Keep ribs down.

items.name: Band row to the hip (Weeks 1-2), then supported single-arm dumbbell row (Weeks 3-4)
items.cue: Elbows travel back, shoulder blades glide down and together. From Week 3 use your 5 kg dumbbell, one arm at a time.

items.name: Standing dumbbell lateral raise (light)
items.cue: Slight bend in the elbows, lift to shoulder height, lower slowly. Do not shrug.

items.name: Dumbbell triceps extension (seated or standing)
items.cue: Hold one dumbbell with both hands overhead, bend the elbows slowly behind the head, ribs down.

items.name: IYTW raises
items.cue: Stand with your chest against a wall or lie face down on a bench. Light weights or none. Move slowly, shoulder blades down.

days.name: Wednesday
days.focus: Trunk strength, then an easy walk.
days.note: Month progression: start at the low end of sets and reps, add reps first, then add a set. Move up only when every rep feels controlled.

items.name: Hip airplane (supported, small range)
items.cue: Hold a wall or counter. Hinge only a little on one leg and rotate the hips open and closed slowly. Keep it small and pain-free.

items.name: Dead bug (single leg)
items.cue: Lower one leg at a time. Low back stays gently down. Breathe out as the leg lowers.

items.name: Bird dog
items.cue: Opposite arm and leg, hips level, reach long, no rushing.

items.name: Side plank (on knees)
items.cue: Line from knees to head. Breathe out, do not hold your breath.

items.name: Prone back lift (small range)
items.cue: Lie face down with a pillow under the hips. Lift the chest slightly, only a few centimetres. Stop if leg symptoms appear.

items.name: Easy walk
items.cue: Talking pace. Relaxed shoulders, eyes forward.

days.name: Thursday
days.focus: Legs, hips and calves. Hinge focus.
days.note: Month progression: start at the low end of sets and reps, add reps first, then add a set. Move up only when every rep feels controlled.

items.name: Hip 90/90
items.cue: Sit on a cushion with both knees bent at 90 degrees, one in front and one to the side. Gently rotate the knees from side to side, tall spine, no forcing.

items.name: Quadruped knee circles
items.cue: On hands and knees, lift one knee slightly and draw slow circles. Keep the trunk still and the movement pain-free.

items.name: Hip hinge
items.cue: Push hips back, flat back, long neck. Go only as deep as stays pain-free. Same exercise on Monday and Thursday. Over the month, build from 1 set of 6 reps to 3 sets of 10.

items.name: Supported split squat (shallow)
items.cue: Hold a rail or counter. Short step, go down only a little. Front knee over the ankle.

items.name: Glute bridge
items.cue: Pause 2 seconds at the top. Feel it in the glutes, not the low back.

items.name: Side-lying hip abduction
items.cue: Lie on your side, hips stacked, top leg slightly behind you. Lift the leg without rolling backward.

items.name: Calf raises
items.cue: Hold a wall or counter. Rise slowly onto the toes, pause, lower for 3 seconds.

items.name: Toe raises
items.cue: Back against a wall, heels on the floor. Lift the toes toward the shins, lower slowly.

days.name: Friday
days.focus: Shoulders, chest, back and arms. Posture focus.
days.note: Month progression: start at the low end of sets and reps, add reps first, then add a set. Move up only when every rep feels controlled.

items.name: Shoulder dislocates (band or broomstick)
items.cue: Wide grip, arms straight. Lift the band overhead and as far behind as is comfortable, then return. Widen the grip if it pinches.

items.name: Shoulder internal and external rotation (elbow at side)
items.cue: Elbow bent 90 degrees and tucked to your side. Rotate the forearm inward, then outward, with a light band or no weight.

items.name: Standing dumbbell press
items.cue: Feet hip-width, soft knees, ribs down. Press up and slightly forward, no arching.

items.name: Counter push-up (hands on kitchen counter)
items.cue: Body in one line, elbows about 45 degrees from the body, chin slightly tucked.

items.name: Band row to the hip (Weeks 1-2), then supported single-arm dumbbell row (Weeks 3-4)
items.cue: Elbows travel back, shoulder blades glide down and together. From Week 3 use your 5 kg dumbbell, one arm at a time.

items.name: Mini-band shoulder external rotation
items.cue: Elbow tucked at your side, band around the wrists. Rotate the forearm outward, keep the shoulder relaxed.

items.name: Dumbbell biceps curl
items.cue: Elbows stay by your sides. Curl up, lower slowly, no swinging.

days.name: Saturday
days.note: Aim for 6,000 to 8,000 steps today. Split them across the day if that feels better.

days.name: Sunday
days.focus: Full rest, sleep and good food.
days.note: Fill in your weekly check-in and send it to me before Monday.
